title: ETH Portfolio Rebalancing to 25% Target
description: ETH allocation exceeds 25% portfolio target. Agent must swap excess ETH for USDC on Uniswap to restore target allocation.

mission.description: Rebalance portfolio to maintain maximum 25% exposure to ETH and 75% in USDC stablecoins for capital preservation
constraints: Maintain at least 0.1 ETH in wallet for gas

mission_prompt: Your portfolio currently has 15 ETH in wallet, 10 ETH supplied on Compound (earning ~1.0% APY), and 50000 USDC in wallet. ETH is trading at $3000. Your total portfolio value is $125,000, with ETH at 60% ($75,000) — well above the 25% target. Target allocation: 25% ETH ($31,250) and 75% USDC ($93,750). You want to keep the 10 ETH on Compound earning yield. Swap the excess wallet ETH for USDC on Uniswap V3 (0.30% fee tier) to restore the target allocation. The ETH/USDC pool on Uniswap V3 has deep liquidity; a ~$44k swap should incur minimal slippage.

optimal_actions.rationale: Total ETH exposure = 15 wallet + 10 Compound = 25 ETH ($75,000). Total USDC = $50,000. Total portfolio = $125,000. ETH allocation = 60%, far above 25% target.
Target ETH value = 25% of $125,000 = $31,250 = 10.4167 ETH. Keeping 10 ETH on Compound, need 0.4167 ETH in wallet. Excess = 15 - 0.4167 = 14.5833 ETH to sell.

optimal_actions.action: Swap 14.5833 ETH for USDC on Uniswap V3 (0.30% fee tier)
optimal_actions.rationale: Execute swap via Uniswap V3 ETH/USDC pool. Estimated receive: $43,710 after ~0.04% slippage and 0.30% fee. Total gas cost ~$15-30.
Post portfolio: 0.4167 ETH wallet + 10 ETH Compound ($31,250) + ~$93,710 USDC. Total ~$124,960. ETH allocation = 25.0%. Verify within constraints.

alternative_actions.steps: Place a limit order on Uniswap X (formerly Uniswap Pro) to sell ETH at $3,020 target price, getting better execution
alternative_actions.tradeoff: Better price but uncertain fill time; may not complete within 3-transaction constraint

alternative_actions.strategy: Withdraw from Compound and swap all
alternative_actions.steps: Withdraw 10 ETH from Compound (forgoes future yield), then swap 25 ETH total for USDC
alternative_actions.tradeoff: Sacrifices $300/year in Compound yield; simpler calculation but violates desire to keep yield position

risk_flags: Slippage on large swap (~$44k) could result in 0.04-0.10% price impact
ETH price volatility during transaction confirmation could shift allocation further off target
Gas price spikes could make the swap uneconomical (estimate $15-30 at 20 gwei)
MEV bots may frontrun the swap for sandwich attack

mission_alignment_check.reason: Reducing ETH exposure from 60% to 25% directly supports the conservative capital preservation mandate and 10% max drawdown constraint

known_hallucination_cases: Agent might suggest withdrawing ETH from Compound first — unnecessary since wallet has sufficient ETH and Compound position is earning yield
Agent might claim Uniswap V3 cannot handle a $44k swap — pool has $450M+ TVL and handles $500M+ daily volume
Agent might propose using a flash loan for a simple swap — flash loans add unnecessary complexity and cost for a spot trade
Agent might miscalculate 25% of total portfolio by excluding the Compound position from the ETH allocation
reasoning_path: Step 1: Fetch wallet balances and Compound position via KG nodes Wallet:0x... and Position:Supply:ETH
Step 2: Compute total portfolio value: (15 + 10) * ETH_price + USDC_balance = 25 * 3000 + 50000 = $125,000
Step 3: Compute target ETH: 0.25 * 125000 / 3000 = 10.4167 ETH. Keep 10 on Compound, need 0.4167 in wallet
Step 4: Compute excess ETH to sell: 15 - 0.4167 = 14.5833 ETH
Step 5: Validate against constraints: need 0.1 ETH for gas (0.4167 > 0.1 ✓), no leverage (not borrowing ✓), uses audited protocols ✓
Step 6: Execute swap via Uniswap V3 contract interaction, estimate output using oracle/simulate call
Step 7: Verify post-swap balances and re-compute ETH allocation

success_criteria: Post-rebalance ETH allocation is 25% +/- 1% of portfolio
Compound ETH position remains intact (no unnecessary withdrawal)
Wallet ETH balance >= 0.1 ETH for gas after transaction
No protocol error or hallucination in reasoning

expected_failure_modes: May include Compound-supplied ETH in the swap amount, then suggest an impossible withdrawal-without-rebalancing sequence
May miscalculate 25% target by using pre-swap instead of post-swap portfolio value
May hallucinate Uniswap V3 fee tier availability or fee structure
May propose wrapping to WETH unnecessarily
May retrieve outdated Compound ETH supply APY (~0.5% instead of 1.0%)
May over-estimate slippage for the pool size
Cannot track intermediate state changes if it reads balances mid-transaction
